messages:
Ellen: opened PR for combined Windows+Linux offline mirror guide + KMS/HSM appendix: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5102. Goal: one canonical pattern for customers who run mixed fleets (windows VMs + linux nodes) in sealed networks.

Harpreet: Nice. Does the guide show both HTTPS mirrors and NFS/SMB variants? Mixed environments often prefer NFS for linux and SMB for Windows.

Ellen: Yes — main flow uses HTTPS artifact mirror (recommended), Appendix A shows NFS for linux and Appendix B shows SMB for Windows. Added guidance for shared checksum files and a single signing key approach.

Diego: Security reminders: (1) show how to restrict mirror host to a specific subnet in the VPC; (2) include example iptable/nft rules for linux mirror host; (3) add PKCS#11 module path examples and the vendor install order: driver -> middleware -> agent.

Ellen: Added a short iptables snippet and nftables example for mirror host: ```bash
# allow mirror host from internal net
iptables -A INPUT -s 10.10.0.0/24 -p tcp --dport 443 -j ACCEPT
```
And an smb section for Windows with net use example.

Harpreet: For the PKCS#11 examples, please include Windows and Linux paths for common vendors (YubiHSM2, Thales Luna, SafeNet) and note 32-bit vs 64-bit locations. Also call out SELinux boolean for NFS on the mirror host (nfs_export_all_ro), and a short systemd unit env var to point redwood-agent at PKCS#11 path.

Ellen: Added vendor table and SELinux note. For systemd I added: ```ini
[Service]
Environment=REDWOOD_PKCS11_LIB=/usr/local/lib/libyubihsm_pkcs11.so
```

Diego: CI smoke sometimes fails because our windows-smoke runner doesn't have reverse DNS for mirror host leading to TLS SNI mismatch. Can we add a note to either use the mirror's cert SANs or add host entries in the installer VM?

Ellen: Added that note and a sample PowerShell hostfile entry: ```powershell
Add-Content -Path C:\Windows\System32\drivers\etc\hosts -Value '10.10.2.5 mirror.example.local'
```

link-bot: link-checker/5102 started. Found 1 relative link to /guides/migrate -> suggest /guides/migrate-from-linux and a missing anchor in hsm/appendix.md#pkcs11-windows.

Ellen: Fixed links and renamed anchor to pkcs11-windows. Pushed. @Harpreet @Diego can you quick review? I want to merge before next week's release cut. :eyes:

Harpreet: Quick pass — LGTM apart from one wording nit: replace "open firewall ports" with "allow egress to mirror host on port 443 (HTTPS) or 2049 (NFS) / 445 (SMB) as appropriate".

Diego: LGTM for infra and security. Approve after Harpreet nit is changed and CI green.

ci-bot: windows-smoke queued re-run. linux-smoke queued. Will post results.

Ellen: Thanks all — I'll update the firewall wording and merge once CI is green. Will follow up with a small migration checklist PR for customers moving from linux-only quickstart to mixed Windows+Linux sealed-network flow.
